v2_partnership.Notes: Biggest governance change in OpenAI history. Enables Bedrock distribution (GPT-5.4 on AWS). E15 from May 7 digest.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: Revenue-share cap restructured. Exclusive IP license removed. AGI clause removed. Capped profit structure ends. OpenAI can now sell through non-Microsoft channels.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: Ends Microsoft exclusivity. Opens multi-cloud for OpenAI. But also removes the structural lock-in that was OpenAI's only competitive moat against Anthropic's tri-cloud architecture.

v2_partnership.Notes: MSFT investing in both OpenAI and Anthropic. Revenue-share cap with OpenAI restructured (E15). Anthropic is the hedge position.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: $5B equity. $30B Azure cloud commitment. Part of MSFT diversification away from OpenAI single-vendor dependency.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: Third hyperscaler leg. Completes Anthropic's tri-cloud architecture. Creates governance complexity (three investors who are also infrastructure providers).

v2_partnership.Notes: Rival becomes supplier. Biggest single-day CI change in NEXUS history. SpaceX gets revenue diversification beyond Starlink.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: Anthropic leases entire Colossus 1 cluster: 222,000 NVIDIA GPUs, 300+ MW. Live capacity within 30 days of announcement.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: Transforms Anthropic's compute stack overnight. Reduces hyperscaler dependency (CI +0.3). Creates the paradox of a competitor-supplier relationship.

v2_partnership.Notes: Cornerstone of Builder and Banker thesis. Anthropic's consumption appears in AWS 28% revenue growth. AWS operating margin 37.7% means Amazon profits from Anthropic's compute spend.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: $5B equity investment. $100B 10-year AWS cloud commitment (Trainium + Graviton). Amazon can add up to $20B additional equity.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: Largest single obligation in Anthropic's stack. Creates structural mutual dependency — Amazon profits from Anthropic's growth, Anthropic dependent on AWS infrastructure.

v2_partnership.Notes: Japan sovereign AI thesis test case. NEC stock entry zone ¥12,200-12,600 from digest.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: Claude Code deployment to 30,000 NEC engineers. First Japan-based Anthropic global partner. Sovereign AI market entry.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: First non-hyperscaler enterprise deployment at scale. Validates sovereign market strategy. Opens Japan as first Anthropic international revenue anchor.

v2_partnership.Notes: Second-largest Anthropic obligation. Feeds GCP's 63% growth rate directly. Backlog doubled to $460B partly on this deal.
v2_partnership.Key Terms: $10B equity now. Up to $30B milestone-contingent. 5GW Cloud TPU capacity commitment.
v2_partnership.Strategic Significance: Multi-GW TPU commitment diversifies Anthropic away from pure NVIDIA dependency. Alphabet gets structural demand floor for GCP.

timeline_dated_events.Description: Fortune (exclusive, March 26) reported that Anthropic accidentally exposed a draft blog post in a publicly searchable data cache revealing a new model called Claude Mythos, internally branded Capybara. Anthropic confirmed existence to Fortune: 'a step change' and 'most capable we've built to date' with 'meaningful advances in reasoning, coding, and cybersecurity.' Capybara is positioned as a new tier above Opus — more capable AND more expensive. Model plans and executes sequences of actions autonomously across systems. Key risk: Anthropic's own draft described it as 'currently far ahead of any other AI model in cyber capabilities' and warned it 'presages an upcoming wave of models that can exploit vulnerabilities in ways that far outpace defenders.' Cybersecurity stocks (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Fortinet) fell on the news. Axios (March 29): Anthropic privately warning senior government officials that Mythos makes large-scale cyberattacks significantly more likely in 2026. Chinese state-sponsored group previously used earlier Claude model to attack ~30 orgs. Model in early access testing only; no general release date due to compute cost. NOTE: '10-trillion parameter' claim appears only in YouTube summaries (AI Grid, World of AI) — not confirmed by Fortune/Axios — treat as unverified speculation.
timeline_dated_events.Score Impact: Positive for MD — new model tier above Opus widens technical moat if deployed. Positive for RQ — enterprise/govt cybersecurity contracts at premium pricing. Negative for GO — unprecedented cyber risk creates regulatory exposure and potential deployment restrictions. Net: strong MD signal; watch regulatory response.

timeline_dated_events.Description: Following SpaceX's record-breaking IPO, Anthropic is identified as one of the major companies expected to pursue a large public offering. The SpaceX debut is described as paving the way for a wave of enormous offerings from companies including Anthropic and OpenAI. Anthropic publicly disputed the decision, arguing that a narrow jailbreak finding should not be grounds for recalling a model deployed to hundreds of millions of users. The move represents a significant escalation of AI regulation and a potential backfire of Anthropic's own safety-focused public positioning.

Senior Trump administration officials have publicly criticized Anthropic, accusing it of regulatory capture and ideological bias.

timeline_dated_events.Description: The Trump administration's decision forced Anthropic to pull its latest cybersecurity models from availability. timeline_dated_events.Description: Anthropic shut off access to its most advanced AI models after a Trump administration order citing national security concerns. The product aims to eliminate the need for researchers to switch between multiple databases, pipelines, and tools. It focuses on workflow integration rather than introducing a new underlying AI model.

timeline_dated_events.Description: Anthropic's annualized recurring revenue (ARR) reached $44B in mid-2026, growing from $9B with a doubling cycle of every 6 weeks. This growth rate exceeded historical benchmarks set by Zoom during COVID and Google in the early 2000s.
timeline_dated_events.Event Title: Anthropic ARR reaches $44B, doubling every 6 weeks in 2026

timeline_dated_events.Description: Anthropic is discovering security vulnerabilities in Microsoft systems faster than Microsoft can patch them. This suggests Anthropic's AI capabilities are being used to identify exploits before hackers find them.

timeline_dated_events.Event Title: Anthropic ARR reaches $74.1B, surpassing OpenAI by 1.79x

timeline_dated_events.Description: A judge approved Anthropic's $1.5 billion copyright settlement with authors. Only 350 authors opted out of the settlement, indicating broad acceptance of the agreement.

timeline_dated_events.Description: California announced a first-of-its-kind statewide agreement with Anthropic aimed at expanding the responsible use of artificial intelligence across state government.
